title: Departure from the anchor
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean machine, let $q_v,q_i$ be designated states, and let $x,s$ be Boolean words. Starting from the canonical seam configuration on input $x$, in administrative anchor state $0$, with $s$ on tape zero and all other tapes empty, one step of the active body yields the two-ended configuration in verification mode, with source state $q_v$, $s$ preserved on tape zero, the last tape blank, both endpoint heads at $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: Canonical seam configuration in anchor state $0$ with $s$ on tape zero and remaining tapes empty
replaced:
For every input $x$ and candidate word $s$, one step of the active enumerator body
from the anchor state over the canonical seam carrying $s$ on tape zero yields the
two-ended configuration that enters the verification call (the source's verifier
entry state in verification mode), with tape zero $s$, a blank capture tape, and
both endpoint heads at zero; the step writes nothing, moves no head, and emits
nothing.
